temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices that Gary is working excessively long hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. When Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, Gary declines because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was a dedicated, hardworking friend who might be overworking because of hospital demands, but Ethan was already concerned about the toll on Gary's health.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's refusal confirms that the work pressure is severe and that Gary is not yet willing or able to step away, despite Ethan's concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is dangerously overcommitted to hospital work and resistant to taking a break; his concern for Gary's health is stronger.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, and somewhat disappointed but still caring.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary address his overwork and find another way to support or persuade him toward rest.

temporal_state_chain.observed: At the retreat, Ethan observes Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary admits the situation is complicated and says he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary's overwork was mainly driven by hospital obligations, though he remained concerned that Gary was reluctant to open up or step away from work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's restless behavior and avoidance, along with his admission that it is complicated, suggest there are deeper personal or emotional issues behind the overwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is struggling with more than professional demands and needs nonjudgmental support to reveal what is really going on.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently confront Gary, encourage him to share, and offer help without judgment.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges. He agrees with Ethan's suggestion to prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed there were deeper issues behind Gary's overwork and that Gary was reluctant to burden others, but Ethan did not yet know the specifics.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's disclosure clarifies that his overwork comes from new departmental pressures plus personal challenges, and it shows Gary is willing to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary's overwork is understandable and addressable, and that Gary is ready to work toward a healthier balance with support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule so he can make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary and hears that Gary is making efforts to change. Gary reports feeling less overwhelmed and says he had time for a movie.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary had accepted help and was trying to improve his work-life balance, but Ethan was likely still monitoring whether the changes would last.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's reported progress and continued efforts show that the changes are producing real improvement and reducing his overwhelm.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is improving and can sustain a healthier balance with continued support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, encourage Gary, and offer support whenever Gary needs to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Ethan sees that Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and can manage on his own. Gary thanks Ethan for his support and says he feels more in control.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary had been making steady progress but might still benefit from regular support and check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's successful adjustment and independence indicate that he no longer needs active intervention from Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary has achieved a sustainable work-life balance and can manage independently, while Ethan remains available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfied, happy, proud, and relieved for his friend.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back and let Gary manage on his own while remaining available if Gary ever needs help.
